configuration.adapter: float selected scalar -> Fraction.from_float; no normalization; h clip explicit if outside [0,1]
configuration.bayes_score: native predictive std diagnostics on h_B only, no transfer to h_L
configuration.cost_matched: NOT_ESTABLISHED; same coverage rank summaries descriptive only
configuration.no_retuning: No thresholds/budgets/seeds changed on outcomes; no real/hidden data
